## Derivative accumulation equals endpoint change

The scientific schematic gives one explicit instance of the endpoint-difference theorem: the derivative 2t accumulates from 0 to 2 to the same value as the change in t².

The theorem makes differentiation and integration inverse processes under precise analytic hypotheses. It is a central organizing principle of calculus and analysis.
